newsitem.title: USA: Olympic Financial seeks to redeem debt.
newsitem.headline: Olympic Financial seeks to redeem debt.

text.p: Olympic Financial Ltd said Tuesday it is offering to buy back all of its outstanding 13 percent senior notes due 2000 at $1,117.50 for each $1,000 principal amount.

In connection with the offer, the company is soliciting consents from holders of the 13 percent notes to amend terms to remove substantially all financial covenants. It is offering to pay tendering noteholders a consent fee of $20 for each $1,000 principal amount.
It also proposes to make a $300 million public offering new senior notes.

Olympic, a consumer finance company, said proceeds from its offering will be used to buy back up to $145 million principal amount of its outstanding 13 percent senior notes due 2000 as well as for general corporate purposes.
It said the public offering is expected to begin during the week of February 3 and will be made only by means of a prospectus under the company's shelf registration statement.
Olympic's offer to purchase and consent solicitation will expire at midnight EST on February 18.
